{{Quote|Who cares? It's Duncan and Gerlon fighting. It's not like we're going to see anything good.|The man talking to another dueling fan before a duel between Deadeye Duncan and Gerlon Two-Fingers|<ref name="KOTOR" />}}
During the [[Jedi Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]], a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''dueling fan''' lived on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|city world]] of [[Taris/Legends|Taris]]. Along with [[Unidentified female dueling fan|another fan]], he was unable to get tickets for a dueling match between [[Deadeye Duncan]] and [[Gerlon Two-Fingers]] in the [[Upper City Cantina]]{{'s}} [[Taris dueling ring|dueling ring]]. The two were forced to watch the duel on a [[Viewscreen/Legends|viewscreen]] in the [[Upper City Cantina]].<ref name="KOTOR" />
